ingress.description: How the public surfaces are published (#24).

mode.description: ingress renders Ingress objects; gateway renders Gateway API HTTPRoutes (see ingress.gateway).

enabled.description: superset.enabled and airflow.enabled cannot both be true in one release: the Superset chart's bundled Redis and the Airflow chart define redis.serviceAccountName with different signatures. Enable one here and install the other as its own release (docs/install.md, 'Heavy components').
